name: Pixel Herdr Circuit
summary: A vertical that turns a project into a pixel-art office driven by Herdr's live agent runtime.
description: Bundles the Pixel Office kit with the Herdr bridge: agents appear in the office automatically from Herdr's per-pane semantic state, liveness, foreground working directory (auto-room), model tokens, and workspace/space context. Quests and task text remain office-owned. Degrades to the plain Pixel Office kit when Herdr is not running.

integrations.name: herdr
integrations.description: Optional live agent runtime. When present, HERDR_SOCKET_PATH or HERDR_ENV=1 activates the bridge.
